stories.title: Razer Basilisk V4 Pro Review: Tried and true and now with AI
stories.summary: Razer's Basilisk V4 Pro gaming mouse features an ergonomic shape, a lighter weight, and a couple of extra buttons, plus Razer's Focus Pro 50K optical sensor.

stories.title: Micron's next-generation 3D NAND to double bit density with over 400 layers, offering extreme performance
stories.summary: Micron's G11 3D NAND promises 42 Gb/mm2 and 5,400 MT/s interface speed, enabling SSDs with extreme capacity and performance.

stories.title: Solidigm confirms plans to build a fab in the US, abandons IPO plans
stories.summary: SK hynix abandons IPO plans for Solidigm, confirms plans to build a Solidigm 3D NAND fab in the U.S.

stories.title: Gigabyte Z890M Aorus Elite WiFi7 Motherboard Review: Icy-white SFF board offers full-size features for Intel
stories.summary: The $209 Gigabyte Z890M Aorus Elite Wifi 7 Ice is one of the better-looking Micro ATX boards, with an icy-white aesthetic and full heatsink coverage that give it a premium vibe for white-themed Intel builds.

stories.title: OLED on a budget, save $50 now on the Acer Predator XB27OU at Best Buy
stories.summary: Upgrade your gaming monitor with this fantastic $329 deal on the Acer XB27OU 27-inch QD-OLED gaming monitor at Best Buy. Save $50 instantly.

stories.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia
stories.summary: Amazon has ditched its plans to build four new data centers in Loudoun County, Northern Virginia, following an outcry from local residents and officials. The land will now be repurposed for mixed and residential use.

stories.title: China can make advanced chips without EUV, but the bill keeps growing
stories.summary: China has stretched older DUV lithography far further than expected, using multiple patterning to approach 5nm-class without EUV. But experts say the trade-offs in cost, yield, and die size mean further advancements are unlikely to be economically viable.

stories.title: Bambu Lab teases its mysterious H3C tool changer 3D printer
stories.summary: Bambu Lab’s long-awaited tool changer H3C launches Nov. 3, 2026.

stories.title: Illegal Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs found inside state-owned China Telecom's network
stories.summary: A security firm has been able to identify 32 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 AI chips running inside a China Telecom network, but it's unclear where the export-barred components are physically located.

stories.title: FCC issues first bans under new chip-level rule
stories.summary: FCC bans a dashcam and wireless video transmitter produced by HiSilicon, a subsidiary of Huawei for containing an AI chip that advertises face detection algorithms.

stories.title: Deepseek's latest AI model is smarter than ever, but its low running costs come at a price
stories.summary: Deepseek 4.1 Flash 1017 drives cost-per-task further down still — open-weight model is fit for agentic workloads and exceedingly cheap to run

stories.title: UK proposes 14-year prison sentences for undersea cable saboteurs amid Russian trawler threats
stories.summary: The UK government has outlined plans for new powers and criminal offenses to help protect undersea cables in UK waters amid fears of Russian interference.

stories.title: US banks scramble to restrict AI agent activity
stories.summary: Several U.S. banks are blocking AI agents from making transactions on their platforms. They fear that those agents could go rogue and there's no way to tell if the moves they make are legitimate or not.

stories.title: Consultant comes clean for sparking worldwide panic by accidentally breaking the PHP vulnerability embargo
stories.summary: The user said that they only wanted to alert others about the importance of the upcoming CVE releases and weren't told about the embargo.

stories.title: Claude and Grok among AI agents used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions
stories.summary: Claude and Grok are among the AI agents that are being used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions, including banks and payment apps, by a group calling themselves CyberCartel.

stories.title: China-aligned hackers deploy AI agents in massive ConnectWise supply chain attack
stories.summary: Microsoft says China-aligned Storm-0940 used the ARTEX AI agent framework in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.

stories.title: Save $450 on this 4K gaming PC with an RTX 5070 Ti and 9800X3D, now $2,549.99

stories.title: Wolves roam into Finnish villages after Google destroys 1,300 acres of forest for AI data centers

stories.title: The original Apple iPod debuted 25 years ago today
stories.summary: On this day in 2001, Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the original iPod. He began the presentation by teasing 'a breakthrough digital device that’s not a Mac.'

stories.title: GPUs from stolen $470,000 Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment at Brazil airport appear for sale online, identified by serial numbers

stories.title: Sony Japan marks last standalone 4K Blu-ray player as ‘Discontinued’

stories.title: TSMC is seeking chipmaking equipment that doesn't contain Chinese rare-earth magnets

We found that creating a custom 1920x1080-equivalent resolution for its 3:2 screen, missing from its out-of-the-box config, makes for a better experience.

stories.title: Leaked private keys for eight CA certificates let any attacker impersonate any domain

stories.title: Micron pulls the plug on future 4F² DRAM after two decades of research in dramatic shift
stories.summary: Micron believes that more advanced process technologies will present more benefits in terms of DRAM bit density than smaller memory cells.

stories.title: Retro Atari VCS platform will end with the closure of its software store in February 2027

stories.title: EA is closing BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age, after more than 30 years
